verdicts.evidence: lines 578, 589, 599, 453: Find rooms calls search(), Book room calls book(), Book another room pushes state and routes back to the form, Try again calls search(true). No button lacks a handler.

lines 390, 401, 462-483, 525, 546-564: rooms come from api.findRooms and the confirmation from the api.createBooking result; no hardcoded sample records or placeholder text. Empty result shows 'No rooms free' (446-448).

lines 136-169 stay visible above the room list; lines 196, 494-500: summary line beside Book room shows chosen room, date, time range and people; stale state (455-456) hides the booking form when criteria no longer match.

lines 317-344, 587, 592, 597, 608-613: every input saves a draft to sessionStorage; reload restores fields, room choice and re-runs the search. Server failure paths (397-399, 534-536) leave fields untouched. Back and Forward use history.state (539, 603).

lines 154, 165, 186, 299-307, 414-419: defaults are 1 hour, 2 people, next working slot, catering unticked, smallest room that fits preselected. Enter submits Find rooms or Book room, neither destroys data; nothing costly is pre-ticked.
lines 133-201: criteria, room choice, meeting details and Book room are all on one page with no dialog or extra screen; the confirmation view (203-209) appears only after the booking is made.

lines 136-209: criteria form, free rooms list, meeting title, catering, note for reception, summary, confirmation details and Book another room all map to tasks in the brief. No stat cards, tips or extra panels.

line 427: Find rooms drops btn-primary when status is ready, so Book room (198) is the only primary then; in other states the booking form is hidden (426). Try again is plain .btn (452). Done view has one button (207).
No action deletes, overwrites or is irreversible; the only actions are Find rooms, Try again, Book room and Book another room (168, 198, 207, 452).

lines 429, 518, 528: buttons get aria-disabled only while their own request is in flight (the exception). When criteria go stale the booking form is hidden (426) and text explains why (456), rather than left greyed out.
No title attributes, tooltips or hover cards anywhere in the markup or script.
All visible strings (lines 134-207, 368-375, 443-456, 489-491, 531-535, 548-563) concern rooms, times and the booking. No mention of implementation, mock data or unfinished features.

lines 448, 450, 456, 489-491, 535: each notice sits at its decision point (empty result, failed load with Try again, stale criteria in the rooms panel, catering conflict under the checkbox, booking failure above Book room). No standing banners or tips.

No text narrates the page. The only guidance is one short line per state at the place it applies: 'Try another time or a shorter meeting' (448), 'Find rooms again to see what is free' (456), catering fix under the checkbox (489-491).
lines 134-198: no subtitles or helper text under headings or labels. Empty state line 448 adds the searched criteria and a next step to the 'No rooms free' heading rather than only restating it.
Headings 'Book a meeting room' (134), 'N rooms free' (445), 'Meeting details' (178), '<room> is booked' (548). No greetings, slogans, exclamation marks or congratulations in any string.

Button labels: 'Find rooms' (168), 'Book room' (198), 'Book another room' (207), 'Try again' (452, directly under 'Could not load the rooms'), busy labels 'Finding rooms...' and 'Booking...' (428, 517). All start with a specific verb.
line 563: row('Booking reference', b.id) shows the raw server id such as 'bk_48213' as a value. Feature enum values are otherwise mapped to words (263, 477-478) and error codes are never displayed.

lines 368-375, 450-454, 489-491, 531-535: each message names the problem and next step ('That time has passed. Choose a later time.', 'Could not load the rooms because the connection failed.' with Try again). e.message and codes are never shown (390, 525).
lines 450 and 535: error text uses the word 'failed' ('because the connection failed'), which the rule's test lists as not allowed. No exclamation marks, capitals or blame of the user otherwise.

lines 446-448: zero rooms gives heading 'No rooms free' and 'Nothing is free for N people on <when>. Try another time or a shorter meeting.' The criteria form with a primary Find rooms button (427) stays directly above as the next action.

lines 442-457: empty result ('No rooms free' plus change the time), failed load (red notice plus Try again), stale criteria ('Find rooms again') and past time (field error on Start time, 392-396) each have their own message and action.

lines 397-399, 449-454: failed load shows a notice and Try again in the rooms panel, fields untouched. Lines 534-536: failed booking shows a notice above Book room, button re-enabled (527-528), title, catering and note kept.

lines 385-387, 428, 442-443: search sets status loading and renders 'Finding rooms...' in the panel and on the button synchronously. Lines 517-519: Book room becomes 'Booking...'. Calls take at most 1.5s, so no progress or cancel is needed.

lines 426, 441-443: in loading state the heading is 'Free rooms', the body is 'Finding rooms...' and the booking form is hidden; 'No rooms free' and counts are only set after the response (401-402, 445-447).

lines 32, 113, 118, 122: overflow-wrap anywhere on h1, room text, summary and dd, with min-width 0 on flex and grid children. Missing note shows 'None' (562); a room with no features renders 'Floor 2, seats 2' (477-478). No undefined or NaN paths found.

lines 317-325, 587, 592, 597, 608-613: unsaved title, note, catering, criteria and room choice are written to sessionStorage on every change and restored on return or reload, so leaving does not discard them.

lines 139-166: no text states 'today or later' or 'whole number, 1 or more' before input; rules appear only in errors (369, 372, 375). But constraints are enforced by native date min (606) and number min (165) and are self-evident. Two readings disagreed.

line 192: 'Note for reception (optional)' with no required attribute; date, start, people and title carry required (140, 145, 165, 181) and are unmarked. Catering is a checkbox, optional by nature. Marking is by words, consistently.

lines 363-377, 508-513: validation runs only inside search() and book(), that is on submit. Input handlers only clear an existing error (580, 591). The catering conflict shows on checkbox or radio change (594-597), not while typing.

lines 141, 146, 166, 182, 189, 347-353: each field has its own error paragraph directly beneath it; marked by 'Error: ' text prefix (70) and a 2px border (67), not colour alone. The connection error, tied to no field, sits above Book room (197).
lines 382, 392-399, 513, 530-536: client and server rejections only set error text and focus; no field is cleared. resetForm runs only after a successful booking (538-540).
lines 351: setError adds aria-invalid and aria-describedby pointing at the message. Lines 382, 396, 513, 531, 533: focus moves to the first invalid field after client or server rejection.

lines 168, 198: neither submit button has a disabled attribute; aria-disabled is set only during the request (429, 518). Submitting with gaps shows what is missing and focuses it (368-375, 382, 508-513).

line 380: search returns early while status is loading. Line 504: book returns early while state.booking is true, with the button showing 'Booking...' and aria-disabled (517-518) until the response (526-528).

lines 385-386, 428: Find rooms renders the loading panel and busy label before awaiting. Lines 515-518: Book room switches to 'Booking...' before awaiting. Room and catering changes update the summary and error at once (594-597). Validation errors are synchronous.

lines 538-541, 546-564: success replaces the form with '<room> is booked' and the booking details. Failures are stated in place (450, 535, 531-533). Search outcome shows as a room count heading or an empty message (445-448).
No success toast, banner or dialog. The confirmation view (203-209, 546-564) is the result itself, which the brief asks for.

No timers dismiss anything (no setTimeout outside the server block). Load failure stays in the panel with Try again until a new search (449-454); the booking error stays until the next attempt (516, 535-536); field errors stay until edited (580, 591).
No action removes, archives, moves or changes an existing item; the flow only creates a booking (525).
No action permanently deletes or overwrites data, sends an unrecallable message or spends money; creating a room booking (525) is the only write.
No confirmation dialogs; no dialog element, confirm() or modal markup in the file.
No optimistic updates: the confirmation view is shown only after createBooking resolves (525, 537-541), and rooms only after findRooms resolves (390, 401).
No modal dialogs in the markup or script.
No modal dialogs in the markup or script.

lines 134-200: the page opens on the h1 and the when, length and people form with the primary Find rooms button; rooms and meeting details follow in task order. Nothing decorative precedes or outweighs them.
lines 133-136: heading 'Book a meeting room' is followed directly by the criteria form. No hero, greeting or introductory panel.
line 445: the only summary number is the 'N rooms free' heading, which tells the user how many options match before picking one. No stat cards or charts.

The room list is the result of mandatory search criteria that stay visible in the form above (136-169), not an optional filter, sort or column setting that could be cleared; there is no filter or search over the returned list.

lines 140-198, 466-470: every control is a native input, select, textarea, radio, checkbox or button inside a form, so Tab, arrows, Space and Enter work. Try again is a real button (451-453). No click-only divs and no focus traps.

line 70: errors carry an 'Error: ' text prefix plus a thicker border (67). Selected room is shown by the native checked radio as well as border and tint (111). The failure notice is worded as a failure, not just red (450).

line 211 live region covers loading, count, empty and booking (387, 407-408, 519). But the load failure is a new p with role=alert inserted with its text (433-440, 450), and the stale message (456) and failure state get no say() call or pre-existing live region.
No accordions, disclosure buttons, custom menus, comboboxes or tabs; the only dropdown is a native select (150).

lines 5, 43-47, 123-127: viewport meta set; the when grid uses auto-fit minmax(150px) and falls to one column at 375px; under 480px buttons go full width and the details list stacks. Inputs are 100% width, 44px tall; long names wrap (113).
